statement_summary: Annual cybersecurity risk assessment feeding the RRA and ERP
Security terms before vendor OT access or data access
Keep RRA, ERP, and certifications at least 5 years
Security changes must not disable hardwired safeguards or manual operation
Unique accounts including on HMIs; no shared logins
MFA for all remote access to OT and for administrators
Vendor remote access only through the gateway with per-session approval and recording
Same-day removal of all access including OT accounts
Change default and commissioning passwords before connecting devices
PLC key switches in RUN; program mode by approval
Report suspected incidents within 1 hour, including unexpected HMI behavior
Move to manual control and verify water quality when SCADA integrity is in doubt
Tier 1 notice and primacy agency consultation within 24 hours when required
Annual OT cyber tabletop with the integrator
Restricted data (RRA, ERP, SCADA diagrams) only in approved locations with named-role access
Unreadable disposal of media and customer records
Offline OT backups monthly and after changes; business backups isolated and tested
Annual awareness and OT role-based training; phishing exercises
No unapproved software or removable media on OT
Approved generative AI tools only; no Restricted data in unapproved tools
